scope: Read-only hashes and arithmetic on retained preparation/UI witness/passive-manifest receipts and unchanged app/archive/pin files. No live store, process, endpoint, model, UI, new host admission, or service calls.

precedingBoundReceipt.sourceMeaning: Parent-recorded monotonic pre-click remaining-time check; no new monotonic/process query.

startLimits: Before/after files are operator-recorded native Start witnesses, not authenticated operating-system event timestamps.
Wall-clock-derived remaining time is consistent with retained spawn time; agreement alone cannot prove the absence of a wall-clock jump.
No inference about overall session completion, eventual writing quality, future resource conditions or provider context processing.
